features.title: The Unified Super IDE Matrix
features.subtitle: Engineered in pure Rust with zero Electron dependencies. Extreme speed meets complete developer infra.
features.multiProjectDesc: Open multiple repositories, frontend monorepos, and backend microservices in a single unified window. Search symbols and jump to definitions across repositories instantly.
features.dbStudioDesc: Direct native drivers for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, and MongoDB. Execute queries, inspect foreign keys, and modify table records without switching to third-party tools.
features.dockerPodsDesc: Manage Docker containers, restart Compose services, and tail Kubernetes pod logs with integrated interactive container terminals and live metrics.
features.aiAgentDesc: Deep full-codebase understanding with Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Zode AI reads live database schemas, checks container error logs, and writes verified code across files.
features.gpuEngineDesc: Engineered in pure Rust on top of GPUI, leveraging direct Metal/Vulkan pipelines for 120 FPS rendering, sub-millisecond typing latency, and sub-5ms cold startup.
features.superTerminalDesc: High-throughput circular buffer terminal capable of handling millions of log lines from Docker streams and compile outputs without a single frame drop.

allInOneShowcase.title: Replace 5+ apps with Zode Super IDE.
allInOneShowcase.subtitle: No more switching between VS Code, DBeaver, Docker Desktop, Terminal apps, and Web AI chats.
allInOneShowcase.multiRepoDesc: Combine backend (Rust/Go), frontend (React/Next), and infra (Terraform/K8s) in one coherent workspace with unified search and terminal panes.
allInOneShowcase.dbDesc: Connect to local or remote databases with 1 click. Run SQL queries, format results as JSON/CSV, view ER diagrams, and edit live rows.
allInOneShowcase.dockerDesc: View container status, CPU/memory usage, inspect environment variables, exec into container shells, and stream logs in real time.
